system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a Helm chart deploying a Java Spring Boot application with a separate config Secret (Spring profile), readiness and liveness probes targeting /actuator/health, and an Ingress with TLS.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Write a Helm chart deploying a Java Spring Boot application with a separate config Secret (Spring profile), readiness and liveness probes targeting /actuator/health, and an Ingress with TLS.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: spring-boot-app
description: Production-grade Helm chart for a Java Spring Boot application
type: application
version: 1.0.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
keywords:
  - spring-boot
  - java
  - microservice
maintainers:
  - name: platform-team
    email: platform@example.com
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 3

image:
  repository: myregistry/spring-boot-app
  tag: "1.0.0"
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

imagePullSecrets: []

nameOverride: ""
fullnameOverride: ""

serviceAccount:
  create: true
  annotations: {}
  name: ""

podAnnotations:
  prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
  prometheus.io/path: "/actuator/prometheus"
  prometheus.io/port: "8080"

podSecurityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  runAsGroup: 1000
  fsGroup: 1000
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault

securityContext:
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  capabilities:
    drop:
      - ALL

service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 80
  targetPort: 8080

ingress:
  enabled: true
  className: nginx
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt-prod
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/force-ssl-redirect: "true"
  hosts:
    - host: app.example.com
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: Prefix
  tls:
    - secretName: app-example-com-tls
      hosts:
        - app.example.com

resources:
  limits:
    cpu: 1000m
    memory: 1Gi
  requests:
    cpu: 250m
    memory: 512Mi

autoscaling:
  enabled: true
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 10
  targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 75
  targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80

nodeSelector: {}
tolerations: []
affinity: {}

springProfile: production

# Sensitive configuration delivered via Secret
config:
  SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: "jdbc:postgresql://db:5432/app"
  SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: "appuser"
  SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: "changeme"
  SPRING_REDIS_HOST: "redis"

livenessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /actuator/health/liveness
    port: http
  initialDelaySeconds: 60
  periodSeconds: 15
  timeoutSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 3

readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /actuator/health/readiness
    port: http
  initialDelaySeconds: 20
  periodSeconds: 10
  timeoutSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 3

startupProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /actuator/health
    port: http
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  periodSeconds: 10
  timeoutSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 30

podDisruptionBudget:
  enabled: true
  minAvailable: 1

networkPolicy:
  enabled: false
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "spring-boot-app.name" -}}
{{- default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "spring-boot-app.fullname" -}}
{{- if .Values.fullnameOverride -}}
{{- .Values.fullnameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" -}}
{{- else -}}
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "spring-boot-app.chart" -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Chart.Name .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "spring-boot-app.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ include "spring-boot-app.chart" . }}
{{ include "spring-boot-app.selectorLabels" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "spring-boot-app.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "spring-boot-app.name" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "spring-boot-app.serviceAccountName" -}}
{{- if .Values.serviceAccount.create -}}
{{- default (include "spring-boot-app.fullname" .) .Values.serviceAccount.name -}}
{{- else -}}
{{- default "default" .Values.serviceAccount.name -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
---
# FILE: templates/serviceaccount.yaml
{{- if .Values.serviceAccount.create -}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: {{ include "spring-boot-app.serviceAccountName" . }}
